# truenas_cloudsync_credentials (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one existing `cloudsync.credentials` object by `id`, `name` or `query_filters`. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Identifier of the object to read.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the cloud credential.
- `query_filters` (String) Middleware query filters as JSON, e.g. `jsonencode([["path", "=", "/mnt/tank/x"]])`. Must match exactly one object.
